title: skills+spec: the taught fieldPatches example patches crm_account.industry's options, but HotCRM's industry is picklist-bound, so a copy is refused at install
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibz5RLVEYDFco93jZ7u

Filing gate: ② an out-of-scope finding of PR #30941 (card #28804, dev report 6685331902), confirmed by contract review 6685496287. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p2.
Dedupe: issue search `fieldPatches picklist` (open and closed): no card on this example. **New.**
Reader: `domain:skills` for `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`. The spec prose and docs pages below are listed for triage to route (spec lane or a fold); this seat takes only the `skills/**` part unless triage folds.

## Business test

The one concrete `fieldPatches` example the platform teaches, in the skill, in the spec's own description and in two docs pages, is a patch the install door refuses. An agent asked to rename a vendor field's options on HotCRM copies it, then gets `picklist-option` from `os validate` or the install. That is a failed customer customization on the flagship app, and the same skill paragraph already says "a `picklist`-bound field's options are never patchable", so the text contradicts its own example.

## What is wrong

- `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` L364: `defineObjectExtension({ extend: 'crm_account', fieldPatches: { industry: { label: 'Sector', options: { technology: { label: 'Tech' } } } } })`.
- HotCRM `main` `src/sales/objects/account.object.ts` (≈L311–318) declares `industry: Field.select({ …, picklist: 'industry' })` with no inline options (`src/sales/picklists/industry.picklist.ts` holds `technology`).
- `fieldPatchTargetMisses` in `packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts` returns reason `picklist-option` for any `options` key on a picklist-bound field. So the install door and `os validate` refuse a verbatim copy, and `registry.ts` `patchedField` skips it (`!picklistBound`).
- The same example appears in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` `fieldPatchesDescription()` (≈L4997–4998) and its TSDoc (≈L5013), in generated `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` (≈L581), and in hand-authored `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` (≈L104–115), which contradicts its own L149–150.
- A prior fix (spec CHANGELOG ≈L3649) changed `tech` → `technology` but left the picklist binding.

## Expected

Every copy of the example patches only what HotCRM's `crm_account.industry` accepts (the `label`), or patches options on a field that declares its own inline options. The `picklist`-bound rule stays stated beside it. The references page is regenerated from the spec description, not hand-edited.

Constraint: the `SKILL.md` rewrite keeps `label: 'Sector'` and `extend: 'crm_account'` as whole tokens. Both are taught at L364 only, and `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` cases 5 and 7 have them as `must_contain` tokens.

Changesets: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` for the skill. The spec description change ships in `@objectstack/spec`, at the level its lane rules set.
